applies_to: Neptronic EVCB14N networkable VAV controllers with integrated damper actuator, pressure-independent or pressure-dependent, with 0-4 triac outputs.
summary: The EVCB14N is an application-specific VAV box controller with built-in actuator and airflow transducer that communicates over BACnet MS/TP. It exposes a fixed table of AI/AO/AV/BI/BO/BV/MSV objects covering zone temperature, setpoints, heating/cooling ramps, airflow balancing and output configuration. Which objects apply depends on the sub-model (triac count, pressure dependent or independent, feedback).
notes: Object availability varies by sub-model; the source marks each object per model.
Multistate state lists depend on other configuration objects.
Airflow values are listed without units; scaling depends on the controller configuration.

source.title: EVCB14N Series BACnet Communication Module User Guide

integration.summary: Read the zone temperature, setpoint, demands and airflow, and drive occupancy with MSV.11. To control from a BMS space temperature, set MSV.4 to Network Sensor and keep writing AV.1 ControlTemp faster than the NetworkTimeOut period (AV.145).

minimum_points.name: ControlTemp
minimum_points.why: Control temperature; written by the BMS when the source is Network Sensor

minimum_points.name: NsbOccCommand
minimum_points.why: BMS occupancy / night setback / off command

minimum_points.name: Cfg_TempControlSource
minimum_points.why: Select internal, external or network temperature

integration.enable: Occupancy and off are commanded with MSV.11 NsbOccCommand: Locally (wired input/sensor decides), Occupancy, No Occupancy (night setback) or OFF. Changeover can also be forced by the BMS through MSV.3 Cfg_ChangeOverControlMode.
integration.heartbeat: AV.145 NetworkTimeOut (0-60 min): when the temperature source is Network/Remote and the BMS has not written a temperature within this time, the EVC goes to OFF and AV.1 shows 999°C in fault. Setting it to 0 makes AV.1 fall back to the AV.15 setpoint value instead.
integration.remote_sensors: Set MSV.4 Cfg_TempControlSource to Network Sensor; AV.1 ControlTemp then becomes writable and must be refreshed by the BMS (see AV.145).
setup: BACnet MS/TP only; the device instance defaults to 153000 + MAC address (auto) and can be changed from the menu or by writing the Device Object_Identifier.
MAC address defaults to 0; baud rate auto-detects (9600/19200/38400/76800), or set it by writing Device proprietary property 1001.
Max_Master defaults to 127; lower it to the highest MAC on the trunk for faster token passing.
A Copy Config function in the menu can clone one controller's configuration to others of the same type on the trunk.
gotchas: Out_of_Service on read-only objects is writable for testing, but it reverts automatically after 15 minutes (Device proprietary property 1002, 0-120 min, 0 = never).
Many multistate objects only offer some states depending on other configuration objects; read State_Text from the device.
Cfg_ objects are commissioning parameters; avoid writing them cyclically from the BMS.
Airflow objects show "No units"; the value follows the airflow scale set on the controller (MSV.41 Cfg_AirFlowScale where present).
